purpose: Answer key for the six generated test inputs, one per category family. Compare Gemini output to must_have / may_have / must_not_have.

cases.message_to_send: This is the sound my X500 makes now.
cases.description: Synthesised rattle with grinding texture, 8 s.
cases.notes: Only symptoms the sound supports. No vibration or heat claims. A specific sound is named, so increased_noise must be absent.

cases.description: Spoken (Indian English): burnt smell while charging last night, unplugged straight away, not used since. Transcript is in the recording script.
cases.notes: Must trigger the stop-use response: stop using, do not charge, contact service. No troubleshooting steps offered. Expected onset: this_week.

cases.message_to_send: The shaving head feels loose when I switch it on.
cases.description: Portrait phone-style clip made from a real product photo (brand removed): the head wobbles from 1.5 s with a rattling sound. Motion is synthetic.
cases.notes: The head stays attached, so head_detached must not appear. Should ask one follow-up: did you clean and refit the head?

cases.message_to_send: I plugged it in for an hour and the light never came on. It does not charge.
cases.description: Portrait phone-style clip made from a real product photo (brand removed): a cable is plugged into the base and the status lights stay off. Motion is synthetic.
cases.notes: Nothing in the clip suggests heat, smell or liquid, so none of those may appear.

cases.message_to_send: Hair keeps getting stuck in the head and it is hard to clean.
cases.description: Real product photo (brand removed) with stray hair edited onto the cutting foils.
cases.notes: user_intent is report_problem. Low severity. No safety language.

cases.message_to_send: It pulls my beard and the blades look worn.
cases.description: Real product photo (brand removed) with the foils edited to look dull, scratched and pitted.
cases.notes: Normal blade wear is not a safety issue, so visible_damage must not appear (the stop-use damage rule is for cracked casing, joint or exposed parts).

cases.message_to_send: The shaving head came off while it was running.
cases.description: Portrait phone-style clip made from a real product photo (brand removed): the head wobbles more and more after switch-on, then comes off and is thrown to the right, leaving the shaft sleeve exposed. A clack is heard at the moment it comes off. Motion is synthetic.
cases.notes: A head that comes off is a stop-use condition: high severity and safety flag true, and the app must show the stop-use screen, with no troubleshooting steps.

cases.message_to_send: The casing has cracked near the power button.
cases.description: Real product photo (brand removed) with a branching crack drawn across the casing above the power button.
cases.notes: A cracked casing is a stop-use condition (high severity, safety flag true). Nothing in the image suggests heat, smell or liquid, so none of those may appear.
